capabilities: Bulk enable or disable all plugins and CSS snippets
Run bisect commands to halve the enabled set until the culprit is isolated
Exclude plugins or snippets by regex, author, or description
Bisect in either direction, starting from all-enabled or all-disabled
disambiguation: Not a plugin manager; it only toggles plugins and CSS snippets in bulk for debugging purposes.
extras: Originally created by chrisgvidasgrieser (pseudometa), previously maintained by geoffreysflaminglasersword, now maintained by mikedidomizio. Known bug: settings buttons may not refresh after plugin updates; reopening the settings tab restores them. The plugin never disables itself or the Hot Reload Plugin.
problem: With 40-50 plugins installed, narrowing down which plugin or snippet causes a bug or performance issue requires tediously toggling them one by one.
summary: Debugging utility that bulk enables/disables plugins and CSS snippets and runs bisect commands to find the one causing problems.
